name: Beijing
tagline: Imperial scale and a Great Wall day
summary: Build the itinerary around the Palace Museum reservation and give the Great Wall its own day. Beijing’s distances are large, so group central heritage, northwest gardens and outer-city excursions separately.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn can be comfortable; winter is cold, summer hot, and major national holidays bring heavy crowds.
arrival: Airport choice matters: Capital and Daxing are far apart. Use the airport rail link or a licensed transfer matched to your terminal.
gettingAround: Metro is efficient; set up a usable payment method and keep your passport available for major attractions.
cashTip: Carry some yuan as backup; mobile payment is common but foreign setup and acceptance can vary.
foodTip: Try roast duck, jiaozi and noodles; book a reputable duck restaurant if it is a highlight.
buyTip: Tea and small crafts make useful souvenirs; avoid high-pressure tea-house invitations and authenticity claims.

connections.note: Typical fast-train journey is roughly 4.5–6 hours; station transfers and booking extra.

items.name: Forbidden City / Palace Museum
items.summary: A huge sequence of imperial courtyards and palace halls.
items.expect: Security, extensive walking and restricted exhibition areas.
items.tip: No same-day ticket sales. Official booking opens seven days ahead at 20:00 Beijing time; book using passport details.
